newsitem.title: USA: James River buys remaining stake in Jamont.
newsitem.headline: James River buys remaining stake in Jamont.

text.p: James River Corp said on Thursday it had completed the acquisition of the remaining minority interest in Jamont NV for $201.4 million, making Jamont a wholly-owned James River subsidiary.
James River said it had bought a 13.6 percent stake in Jamont from EuroPaper Inc.
On a pro forma basis, based on Jamont's results for the first six months of 1996, this transaction would have been nominally accretive to James River's earnings, James River said.
With annual sales of about $1.7 billion, Jamont is a leading producer of branded and private-label tissue and foodservice products for the retail and commercial markets in Europe, James River said.
Jamont was formed in 1990 when James River, Gruppo Ferruzzi of Italy and Nokia Ab of Finland each contributed their European consumer products businesses to the jointly-owned venture.
In 1993 Nokia's interest in Jamont was purchased by EuroPaper, and James River and EuroPaper entered into a fixed-price put and call agreement related to these shares, James River said.
In 1994 James River doubled its ownership interest in Jamont from 43.2 percent to 86.4 percent when it acquired the interest originally owned by Gruppo Ferruzzi.
